name: Cloudloom
lore: A wandering weather-weaver who stitches stray clouds into rain and safe winds.

primary.name: Pocket Rain
primary.description: Send a small cloud forward; it pauses, then releases three aimed raindrops for 8 damage each.

secondary.name: Tailwind Seam
secondary.description: Weave a 400-unit wind lane for 4 seconds. Allies crossing it gain 30% speed; enemies take 7 damage each second.

special.name: Thunder Procession
special.description: Three storm clouds travel forward in sequence. Each strikes each enemy once for 28 damage with visible lightning.

passive: Stormcatcher: Tailwind Seam becomes a visible charged wind lane. It catches up to three hostile moving projectiles, then releases one 10-damage seeking lightning spark per catch. Does not stop floor attacks or lobbed explosions.

technique.name: Distant Rain
technique.description: Pocket Rain reaches 35% farther, for 20% less raindrop damage.

final_technique.name: Cloudburst Atlas
final_technique.description: Three cloudburst warning circles deal 23 each. Replaces Thunder Procession’s moving storm with timed ground impacts.

attack.name: Cloudburst Atlas
attack.description: Three cloudburst warning circles deal 23 each. Replaces Thunder Procession’s moving storm with timed ground impacts.
